tiebreak_notes: AFC No. 6 seed (PIT vs DEN, both 10-7): 'Pittsburgh clinched the #6 seed over Denver based on head-to-head victory.'

NFC West (LAR vs SEA, both 10-7): 'Los Angeles clinched the NFC West and #4 seed over Seattle based on strength of victory. (Los Angeles .441 to Seattle .424)' SOV is the 5th division step, after head-to-head, division record, common games and conference record were all even. Clinched in Week 17. [Corroborated by therams.com, NBC and CBS Sports.]
